messages:
Maya Patel: Quick check — we have Crescent App interview audio + notes. Need to lock final quote and get legal OK before we publish the customer story + webinar blurb. Timeline: publish case study next Wed, webinar promo the day after. :calendar:
Austin Chen: Do we have a preferred quote to feature in the hero? I pulled three candidate lines from the transcript. Shortlist below.
Austin Chen: ```
1) "Redwood cut our inference costs in half while improving tail latency."
2) "We shipped the new recommender in weeks, not months."
3) "The rollout and canary tooling saved us from a major outage."
```
Maya Patel: My pick is #1 for headline, #2 for product body, and #3 as a sidebar quote. Carmen (from CS) confirmed the sentiment.
Carmen Ruiz: +1 on that ordering. Also asked Crescent if they're ok with the phrase "cut our inference costs" — they said yes but asked for the percent to be accurate. They gave a 48% number in the ROI deck.
Taylor Reed: Legal — any red flags on vendor language? Also need the standard release form signed by the customer before we push.
Legal Bot: Automated check: flagged potential comparative claim. Recommend we either cite the 48% figure or soften to "nearly half". Please attach the ROI slide or a signed attestation.
Maya Patel: Attaching ROI slide and the recorded clip timestamp for the quote. Can we get a quick redline on the release form? We have a go/no-go on imaging assets by EOD tomorrow.
Austin Chen: For web copy I drafted a 150-word hero + 300-word body. Pasting hero draft: 
```
Crescent App cut inference costs by 48% and improved 99th-percentile latency, enabling a faster rollout of their new recommender and measurable improvements in user engagement.
```
Maya Patel: Love it. Legal — if we include the 48% number we need source. Will ask Crescent to sign off in email thread.
Legal Bot: If customer attests in email or via the signed release, good to go. Also recommend replacing "improved 99th-percentile latency" with "reduced tail latency" unless they approve the exact metric.
Carmen Ruiz: I'll ping the customer now for explicit approval on the 48% and the 99th P latency callout. I expect reply within 24 hours.
Taylor Reed: Assuming customer confirms, legal can turn around the release redline in < 6 business hours. If they don't confirm, use Austin's softened copy and no numeric claim.
Maya Patel: Next steps: Carmen to confirm metrics with customer; Austin to prepare both the hard and softened web drafts; Taylor/Legal Bot to prep release redline. Target: publish assets to staging by Tue EOD, final publish Wed.
Austin Chen: Also prepping a short webinar promo (30s) and a 1-slide case study summary for SDRs. Will drop assets in #marketing-assets once ready.
Carmen Ruiz: Customer confirmed in email: "We confirm 48% and 99th percentile latency reduction as stated." Forwarding signed attestation now.
Legal Bot: Received attestation. Release redline attached in thread. One small wording tweak suggested for the customer name formatting.
Taylor Reed: Redline done, sent to marketing and customer for sign-off.
Maya Patel: Perfect. Once signed, we'll schedule the publish and the webinar announcement. Thanks team — this one will be a solid proof point for our benchmarks narrative. :rocket:
